claim: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 with real-time multimodal world simulation and native audio in a limited research preview.
verifiedFacts: Google DeepMind published the Genie 4 announcement dated October 27, 2026.
Genie 4 is available to trusted research-preview testers; broader consumer and developer access is prospective.
Google acknowledges object permanence, spatial accuracy, physical interactions, and longer-session consistency limitations.
inference: Genie 4 offers a useful contrasting reference for deterministic WebGL and governed scene compilation, not a substitute for physically calibrated materials.
Potential client problem: rapid immersive previsualization lacks reproducible state and truthfulness checks; consultancy concept: generated-scene evidence audit.
significance: Generative interactive worlds now combine live steering, sound and agent-guided scene progression; controlled reproducibility becomes a differentiated design proof.
assumptions: Preview capabilities will be accessible for independent tests later.
knownLimitations: Preview restricted to trusted testers; provider demos are not independent validation.
